From the current Artemis mission pages on NASA’s website, Artemis II is identified as the next planned Artemis mission.

• Mission name: Artemis II  
• Planned launch year (from NASA page): 2026 (LaunchED April 1, 2026)  
• Destination: Crewed lunar flyby of the Moon  
• Primary objective (from NASA’s Artemis II mission description text): The first crewed Artemis flight, marking a key step toward the long‑term return to the Moon and paving the way for future missions to Mars by sending astronauts on a lunar flyby to test NASA’s human deep space capabilities.
